descripcion_geo: Region in the north of Mesopotamia (present-day northeastern Syria/Türkiye). Abraham Family Home; there Isaac and Jacob took wives.
importancia_estrategica: Land of origin of the patriarchs; Jacob lived there for twenty years with Laban.

historias.titulo: Jacob escapes from Padán to Canaan
historias.descripcion: After twenty years serving Laban in Paddan, Jacob flees with his wives, children and flocks to Canaan; Laban chases him but God stops him.

historias.titulo: Rebekah brought from Padán for Isaac
historias.descripcion: Abraham's servant travels to Paddan and finds Rebekah at the well; He brings her as a wife for Isaac.

historias.titulo: The twelve sons of Jacob born in Padan
historias.descripcion: Eleven of the twelve sons of Jacob (less Benjamin) were born in Padan; The tribes of Israel were formed there.

personajes.descripcion: He lived twenty years in Padan serving Laban; There he married Lea and Rachel.
He deceived Jacob by giving Leah first instead of Rachel; then he tried to hold him back.
Born in Padán; chosen as Isaac's wife by Abraham's servant.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Paddan (Aram-Naharaim): relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Eleven of the twelve patriarchs were born in Paddan-Aram; Jacob received the name Israel there.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Eleven of the twelve patriarchs were born in Paddan-Aram; Jacob received the name Israel there.
